summary: Validated client-side FR/EN→PT redirects after removal of duplicate FR/EN routes in App.js. All 10 redirects work correctly, PT canonical routes render, and admin login is functional.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 175 and 176 both register /parrainage twice with different components (Referrals vs Referral). Second one is dead code — remove duplicate.
App.js is ~293 lines mostly Route definitions; consider splitting into a routes config module for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_10 confirms redirects fix. All FR/EN aliases (/investisseurs, /investors, /calculateurs, /calculators, /prix, /prices, /estimation, /inscription, /reinitialiser, /fonctionnalites) client-side navigate to their PT canonical counterparts. PT canonicals still render their intended components. Login flow intact.
rca of the issue: In iter_9, FR/EN Route entries preceded Navigate redirect entries in App.js, so React Router matched the first FR/EN component route and skipped the redirect. Main agent removed duplicate FR/EN component-route entries at top of Routes, leaving only the single Navigate redirects for those paths. Verified: 10/10 aliases redirect properly.
